# The PNC pilot

Anne has previously conducted some pilot SNF analyses within the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC) dataset.

A main qualitative finding from this pilot was that subtype #3 had reduced performance on the line orientation test, higher likelihood of experiencing LOC, and decreased functional connectivity between the brainstem and occipital cortex. 

The code in those previous analyses (with small adjustments) are shown below.
Only the code outputs relevant to the qualitiative finding above are included.


## Setting up the data

```{r}
library(readr)
library(here)

# rsFMRI
## import
rsfc_data_wb <- read.csv(here(paste0("data/pnc/pilot-snf/",
    "PNC_rsfc_QC_passed_present_in_all_imaging_modalities_whole_brain.csv")),
    check.names = FALSE)


# clinical data
## import
clinical <- read.csv(here("data/pnc/pilot-snf/tbi_pnc_clinical.csv"),
                     check.names = FALSE)
clinical <- clinical[, -1]

## recode factors as numbers 1=yes, 0=no
names(clinical)
clinical$TBI_LOC <- ifelse(clinical$TBI_LOC == "yes", 1, 0)
clinical$TBI_AMN <- ifelse(clinical$TBI_AMN == "yes", 1, 0)
clinical$TBI_HEADACHE <- ifelse(clinical$TBI_HEADACHE == "yes", 1, 0)

clinical_t <- t(clinical)
colnames(clinical_t) <- as.character(unlist(clinical_t[1, ]))
clinical_t <- clinical_t[-1, ]
rownames(clinical_t) <- c()

# remove ppl with no data or NAs
clinical_t <- as.data.frame(clinical_t)
clinical_t <- clinical_t[colSums(!is.na(clinical_t)) > 0]
clinical_t <- clinical_t[sapply(clinical_t,
    function(clinical_t) !any(is.na(clinical_t)))]

### 6: Demographic Info for TBI participants
demographics <- read.csv(here("data/pnc/pilot-snf/tbi_pnc_dem.csv"),
    check.names = FALSE)
demographics <- demographics[, -1]

demographics_datadic <- colnames(demographics)

# recode factors as numbers:
## Sex: 1=male, 2=female, 3=unknown
## Race 1=EA=1, 2=AA=2, 3=other
names(demographics)
demographics$Sex <-
    ifelse(demographics$Sex == "M", 1,
        ifelse(demographics$Sex == "F", 2, 3))

demographics_t <- t(demographics)
colnames(demographics_t) <- as.character(unlist(demographics_t[1, ]))
demographics_t <- demographics_t[-1, ]
rownames(demographics_t) <- c()

# remove ppl with no data or NAs
demographics_t <- as.data.frame(demographics_t)
demographics_t <- demographics_t[colSums(!is.na(demographics_t)) > 0]
demographics_t <- demographics_t[sapply(demographics_t,
    function(demographics_t) !any(is.na(demographics_t)))]


# Checking for same participants across datatypes

# Create vectors with the column names (which are always the subject IDs)
colnames_rsfc <- colnames(rsfc_data_wb)
colnames_clinical <- colnames(clinical_t)
colnames_demographics <- colnames(demographics_t)

# 'common_subs' contains only the IDs found in all datatypes)
common_subs <- Reduce(intersect,
    list(colnames_rsfc, colnames_clinical, colnames_demographics))

# Subset each dataframes to only have information from common_subs
rsfc <- rsfc_data_wb[, which(names(rsfc_data_wb) %in% c(common_subs))]
clinical <- clinical_t[, which(names(clinical_t) %in% c(common_subs))]
demographics <-
    demographics_t[, which(names(demographics_t) %in% c(common_subs))]

# Check for matchine number of participants across datatypes
dim(rsfc)
dim(clinical)
dim(demographics)

# Check the sample names to see if they are in the same order in all 3 datasets
# compare IDs for rsfc and clinical
sum(colnames(rsfc) == colnames(clinical)) == length(colnames(rsfc))
# compare IDs for tract clinical and demographic
sum(colnames(clinical) ==
    colnames(demographics)) ==
    length(colnames(clinical))
```

## Running SNF

```{r}
### Run SNF using PNC data - TBI participants only

# PART 1: SNF SETUP

# load libraries
library(SNFtool)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Perform the standard recommended normalisation
rsfc.norm <- standardNormalization(rsfc)
clinical.norm <- standardNormalization(clinical)
demographics.norm <- standardNormalization(demographics)

# For the subsequent analysis we need to transpose the data
rsfc.norm.tr <- t(rsfc.norm)
clinical.norm.tr <- t(clinical.norm)
demographics.norm.tr <- t(demographics.norm)

# Create silarity matrices for each data frame.
# Hyperparameters:
# 1) the number of neighbours, K (normally between 20 - 30)
# 2) the hyperparameter alpha, which is normally between 0.3 and 0.8
# 3) the number of iterations, usually between 10 and 50

#Before creating the affinity matrices, we need to first create distance matrices
rsfc.dist = dist2(as.matrix(rsfc.norm.tr),as.matrix(rsfc.norm.tr))
clinical.dist = dist2(as.matrix(clinical.norm.tr),as.matrix(clinical.norm.tr))
demographics.dist = dist2(as.matrix(demographics.norm.tr),as.matrix(demographics.norm.tr))

#Now create the similarity matrices (graphs) using the distance matrices and the K, alpha and T parameters
# First, set all the parameters:
K = 10 # number of neighbors, must be greater than 1. usually (10~30), I have used k = 10, as there are 85 subjects and it looks from Laura stefanik's article that k = number of subjets/10
alpha = 0.5 # hyperparameter, usually (0.3~0.8)
T = 50 # number of Iterations, usually (10~50)

# Construct similarity graphs (can be considered to be fully connected networks)
rsfc.sim = affinityMatrix(rsfc.dist, K, alpha)
clinical.sim = affinityMatrix(clinical.dist, K, alpha)
demographics.sim = affinityMatrix(demographics.dist, K, alpha)

# PART 2: SNF RUN
#SNF with rsFC + clinical + demographics 
# first create a list of the 3 similarity "networks"
sim.list <- list(rsfc.sim, clinical.sim, demographics.sim)

# Construct the fused network. This requires the previously defined K (no. neighbours) and T (no. iterations) parameters.
fused.sim = SNF(sim.list, K, T)

# set the row and column names of the fused network to the sample ids
dimnames(fused.sim) <- list(common_subs)

#estimate the number of clusters for fused network
#this command estimates number of clusters - note to add grid search for optimal number of clusters
clusters.est <- estimateNumberOfClustersGivenGraph(fused.sim)

# spectral clustering
# clusters.est as 2(first best) and 3(second best)
clustering.fused.2 <- spectralClustering(fused.sim,2)
clustering.fused.3 <- spectralClustering(fused.sim,3)

# add subject IDs to clustering.fused
common_subs<-as.data.frame(common_subs)
colnames(common_subs)[1] <- "SUBJID"

clustering.fused.2<-as.data.frame(clustering.fused.2)
clustering.fused.2<-cbind(common_subs,clustering.fused.2)
colnames(clustering.fused.2)[2]<- "cluster.2"

clustering.fused.3<-as.data.frame(clustering.fused.3)
clustering.fused.3<-cbind(common_subs,clustering.fused.3)
colnames(clustering.fused.3)[2]<- "cluster.3"

#output a csv with SUBJID and cluster number
#write.csv(clustering.fused.2,
#    file = "data/pnc/pilot-snf/clusters_fused_2.csv")
#write.csv(clustering.fused.3,
#    file = "data/pnc/pilot-snf/clusters_fused_3.csv")

#calculates NMI for rsfc conn and output csv
#NMIScores.rsfc <-rankFeaturesByNMI(list(rsfc.norm.tr),fused.sim)

#write.csv(NMIScores.rsfc, file = "data/pnc/pilot-snf/nmi_rsfc.csv")

#calculates NMI for clinical
#NMIScores.c <-rankFeaturesByNMI(list(clinical.norm.tr),fused.sim)

#write.csv(NMIScores.c, file = "data/pnc/pilot-snf/nmi_clin.csv")

#calculates NMI for demographic
#NMIScores.d <-rankFeaturesByNMI(list(demographics.norm.tr),fused.sim)

#write.csv(NMIScores.d, file = "data/pnc/pilot-snf/nmi_dem.csv")

##### make variable names file
rownames.rsfc <- colnames(rsfc)
rownames.clinical <- colnames(clinical)
rownames.demographics <- colnames(demographics)

var <- cbind(rownames.rsfc, rownames.clinical, rownames.demographics)

# write.csv(var, file = "data/pnc/pilot-snf/variables.csv")
```

## Comparing clusters

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
#library(MASS)


clustering.fused.2<-read.csv(here("data/pnc/pilot-snf/clusters_fused_2.csv"))
clustering.fused.3<-read.csv(here("data/pnc/pilot-snf/clusters_fused_3.csv"))
clustering.fused<-cbind(clustering.fused.2, clustering.fused.3[,3])
colnames(clustering.fused)[4]<- "cluster.3"

# Bring in outcomes .csv 

outcomes<-read.csv(here("data/pnc/pilot-snf/tbi_pnc_outcomes.csv"), fill = TRUE, header = T)

clustering.fused<-merge(clustering.fused, outcomes, by="SUBJID", all.x=T)
clustering.fused[c('X.x')]<-NULL
clustering.fused[c('X.y')]<-NULL


## 2 cluster solution - Demographics
# number of participants in each cluster
clustering.fused$cluster.2<-as.factor(clustering.fused$cluster.2)
summary(clustering.fused$cluster.2)

# wrat in each cluster
# compare clusters for wrat
summary(aov(WRAT_CR_STD ~ cluster.2, data=clustering.fused))
# breakdown of each cluster
mean(subset(clustering.fused, cluster.2==1)$WRAT_CR_STD)
mean(subset(clustering.fused, cluster.2==2)$WRAT_CR_STD)
mean(subset(clustering.fused, cluster.2==3)$WRAT_CR_STD)
mean(subset(clustering.fused, cluster.2==4)$WRAT_CR_STD)

# compare clusters for GAF - Children's Global Assessment Scale - Current
summary(aov(GAF001.y ~ cluster.2, data=clustering.fused))
# GAF breakdown of each cluster
mean(subset(clustering.fused, cluster.2==1)$GAF001.y)
mean(subset(clustering.fused, cluster.2==2)$GAF001.y)
mean(subset(clustering.fused, cluster.2==3)$GAF001.y)

# compare clusters for GAF - Children's Global Assessment Scale - Most Severe Past
summary(aov(GAF002.y ~ cluster.2, data=clustering.fused))
# GAF breakdown of each cluster
mean(subset(clustering.fused, cluster.2==1)$GAF002.y)
mean(subset(clustering.fused, cluster.2==2)$GAF002.y)
mean(subset(clustering.fused, cluster.2==3)$GAF002.y)

# compare clusters for GAF - Children's Global Assessment Scale - Lifetime
summary(aov(GAF003.y ~ cluster.2, data=clustering.fused))
# GAF breakdown of each cluster
mean(subset(clustering.fused, cluster.2==1)$GAF003.y)
mean(subset(clustering.fused, cluster.2==2)$GAF003.y)
mean(subset(clustering.fused, cluster.2==3)$GAF003.y)
```

## Overall connectivity Differences Between Groups 

```{r}
library(psych)

# For the subsequent analysis we need to transpose the data so the rows become columnns and the columns become rows - here this is done on data before normalization
rsfc_data_wb.tr <- t(rsfc_data_wb)
rsfc_data_wb.tr.2<-rsfc_data_wb.tr

# TBI SUBJECTS USED IN THIS ANALYSIS
tbi<-read.csv('data/pnc/pilot-snf/tbi_pnc_subjids.csv')
rsfc_data_wb.tr <- data.frame("SUBJID" = row.names(rsfc_data_wb.tr), rsfc_data_wb.tr)
rsfc_data_wb.tr<-merge(tbi, rsfc_data_wb.tr, by="SUBJID")

# fisher transform rsfc correlation values
rsfc_data_wb.tr.z<-fisherz(rsfc_data_wb.tr.2)
# calculates mean rsFC in each participant by averaging FC row wise
mean_rsfc.z = data.frame(rowMeans(rsfc_data_wb.tr.z))
# convert back to corr value
mean_rsfc<-fisherz2r(mean_rsfc.z)
names(mean_rsfc)[1] <- "mean_rsfc"

# read in clusters
clustering.fused.2<-read.csv(here("data/pnc/pilot-snf/clusters_fused_2.csv"))
clustering.fused.3<-read.csv(here("data/pnc/pilot-snf/clusters_fused_3.csv"))
clustering.fused<-cbind(clustering.fused.2, clustering.fused.3[,3])
colnames(clustering.fused)[4]<- "cluster.3"
clustering.fused[1]<- NULL

# bind
library(data.table)
setDT(mean_rsfc, keep.rownames = "SUBJID")
clustering.fused.con<-merge(clustering.fused, mean_rsfc, by="SUBJID")

# compare clusters for rsFC 
summary(aov(mean_rsfc ~ cluster.3, data=clustering.fused.con))
# rsFC breakdown of each cluster
mean(subset(clustering.fused.con, cluster.3==1)$mean_rsfc, na.rm=TRUE)
mean(subset(clustering.fused.con, cluster.3==2)$mean_rsfc, na.rm=TRUE)
mean(subset(clustering.fused.con, cluster.3==3)$mean_rsfc, na.rm=TRUE)
mean(subset(clustering.fused.con, cluster.3==4)$mean_rsfc, na.rm=TRUE)

## Overall connectivity Differences Between Groups - Plots
clustering.fused.con$cluster.3<-as.factor(clustering.fused.con$cluster.3)

ggplot(clustering.fused.con, aes(x=cluster.3, y=mean_rsfc)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill=c('red','blue', 'green')) + xlab('cluster') + ylab('rsFC') +
  geom_jitter() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=20), axis.text.y=element_text(size=20), axis.title=element_text(size=24)) 

## Compare RSFC 

#compute mean rsFC for each connection within each cluster
rsfc.by.con<-cbind(clustering.fused.con, rsfc_data_wb.tr)


c1.rsfc.by.con<-subset(rsfc.by.con, cluster.3==1)
c1.rsfc.by.con<-c1.rsfc.by.con[,7:ncol(c1.rsfc.by.con)]
c1.rsfc.by.con<-t(c1.rsfc.by.con)
c1.rsfc.by.con<-as.data.frame(c1.rsfc.by.con)
c1.rsfc.by.con$c1.mean<-rowMeans(c1.rsfc.by.con)

c2.rsfc.by.con<-subset(rsfc.by.con, cluster.3==2)
c2.rsfc.by.con<-c2.rsfc.by.con[,7:ncol(c2.rsfc.by.con)]
c2.rsfc.by.con<-t(c2.rsfc.by.con)
c2.rsfc.by.con<-as.data.frame(c2.rsfc.by.con)
c2.rsfc.by.con$c2.mean<-rowMeans(c2.rsfc.by.con)

c3.rsfc.by.con<-subset(rsfc.by.con, cluster.3==3)
c3.rsfc.by.con<-c3.rsfc.by.con[,7:ncol(c3.rsfc.by.con)]
c3.rsfc.by.con<-t(c3.rsfc.by.con)
c3.rsfc.by.con<-as.data.frame(c3.rsfc.by.con)
c3.rsfc.by.con$c3.mean<-rowMeans(c3.rsfc.by.con)

c4.rsfc.by.con<-subset(rsfc.by.con, cluster.3==4)
c4.rsfc.by.con<-c4.rsfc.by.con[,7:ncol(c4.rsfc.by.con)]
c4.rsfc.by.con<-t(c4.rsfc.by.con)
c4.rsfc.by.con<-as.data.frame(c4.rsfc.by.con)
c4.rsfc.by.con$c4.mean<-rowMeans(c4.rsfc.by.con)

# read in Shen Node Info
nodes<-read.csv(here("data/pnc/pilot-snf/Shen-node-annotation.csv"))
# read in Shen edge/connection info
edgelist<-read.csv(here("data/pnc/pilot-snf/edgelist-in-vector.csv"), sep=".", header=F)
edgelist2<-edgelist
edgelist2[]<-lapply(edgelist, function(x) nodes$Lobe[match(x, nodes$Node)])
colnames(edgelist2)<-c("V1.lobe", "V2.lobe")
edgelist3<-edgelist
edgelist3[]<-lapply(edgelist, function(x) nodes$Network.name[match(x, nodes$Node)])
colnames(edgelist3)<-c("V1.network", "V2.network")
edgelist$V1.hem<-ifelse(edgelist$V1<134, "Right", "Left")
edgelist$V2.hem<-ifelse(edgelist$V2<134, "Right", "Left")

edgelist<-cbind(edgelist, edgelist2, edgelist3)

# merge connection information with cluster means
cluster_edges<-cbind(edgelist, c1.rsfc.by.con[c("c1.mean")], c2.rsfc.by.con[c("c2.mean")], c3.rsfc.by.con[c("c3.mean")], c4.rsfc.by.con[c("c4.mean")])

### by Right and Left

cluster_edges.rr<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.hem=="Right" & V2.hem=="Right")
boxplot(cluster_edges.rr[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="Right Right", ylab="rsFC")

cluster_edges.ll<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.hem=="Left" & V2.hem=="Left")
boxplot(cluster_edges.rr[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="Left Left", ylab="rsFC")

cluster_edges.rl<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.hem=="Left" & V2.hem=="Right" | V1.hem=="Right" & V2.hem=="Left")
boxplot(cluster_edges.rr[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="Right Left", ylab="rsFC")


### by Lobe
# all
boxplot(cluster_edges[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="all", ylab="rsFC")

cluster_edges.bs.bs<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.lobe=="brainstem" & V2.lobe=="brainstem")
boxplot(cluster_edges.bs.bs[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="brainstem brainstem", ylab="rsFC")

cluster_edges.cer.cer<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.lobe=="cerebellum" & V2.lobe=="cerebellum")
boxplot(cluster_edges.cer.cer[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="cerebellum cerebellum", ylab="rsFC")

cluster_edges.ins.ins<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.lobe=="insula" & V2.lobe=="insula")
boxplot(cluster_edges.ins.ins[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="insula insula", ylab="rsFC")

cluster_edges.lim.lim<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.lobe=="limbic" & V2.lobe=="limbic")
boxplot(cluster_edges.lim.lim[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="limbic limbic", ylab="rsFC")

cluster_edges.ms.ms<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.lobe=="motor strip" & V2.lobe=="motor strip")
boxplot(cluster_edges.ms.ms[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="motor strip motor strip", ylab="rsFC")

cluster_edges.oct.oct<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.lobe=="occipital" & V2.lobe=="occipital")
boxplot(cluster_edges.oct.oct[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="occipital occipital", ylab="rsFC")

cluster_edges.par.par<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.lobe=="parietal" & V2.lobe=="parietal")
boxplot(cluster_edges.par.par[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="parietal parietal", ylab="rsFC")

cluster_edges.pf.pf<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.lobe=="prefrontal" & V2.lobe=="prefrontal")
boxplot(cluster_edges.pf.pf[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="prefrontal prefrontal", ylab="rsFC")

cluster_edges.sc.sc<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.lobe=="subcortical" & V2.lobe=="subcortical")
boxplot(cluster_edges.sc.sc[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="subcortical subcortical", ylab="rsFC")

cluster_edges.temp.temp<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.lobe=="temporal" & V2.lobe=="temporal")
boxplot(cluster_edges.temp.temp[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="temporal temporal", ylab="rsFC")

cluster_edges.bs.cer<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.lobe=="brainstem" & V2.lobe=="cerebellum" | V1.lobe=="cerebellum" & V2.lobe=="brainstem")
boxplot(cluster_edges.bs.cer[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="brainstem cerebellum", ylab="rsFC")

cluster_edges.bs.ins<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.lobe=="brainstem" & V2.lobe=="insula" | V1.lobe=="insula" & V2.lobe=="brainstem")
boxplot(cluster_edges.bs.ins[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="brainstem insula", ylab="rsFC")

cluster_edges.bs.lim<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.lobe=="brainstem" & V2.lobe=="limbic" | V1.lobe=="limbic" & V2.lobe=="brainstem")
```

This is the original plot comparing brainstem-occipital rsfc across clusters.
The figure does not plot one data point per subject, but rather one data point per edge (?) averaged across all subjects within the cluster.

```{r echo = FALSE, out.width = "50%", message = FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(here("figures/pnc/pilot-snf/3_cluster_bs_oct_rsfc.png"))
```

```{r}
cluster_edges.scn.vis<-subset(cluster_edges, V1.network=="Subcortical" & V2.network=="Visual" | V1.network=="Visual" & V2.network=="Subcortical")
boxplot(cluster_edges.scn.vis[,9:12], notch = TRUE, col=c('red','blue', 'green'), main="Subcortical Visual", ylab="rsFC")

## Compare (RSFC) - connectiviy martrices
library(dils) # Package removed from CRAN!
library(corrplot)
# create edgelist for each cluster

edgelist_c1<-cluster_edges[c("V1", "V2", "c1.mean")]
edgelist_c2<-cluster_edges[c("V1", "V2", "c2.mean")]
edgelist_c3<-cluster_edges[c("V1", "V2", "c3.mean")]
edgelist_c4<-cluster_edges[c("V1", "V2", "c4.mean")]

# create symetrical matrix from edgelist
adjacency_c1<-AdjacencyFromEdgelist(edgelist_c1, check.full = TRUE)
adjacency_c1<-adjacency_c1[["adjacency"]]
t<-t(adjacency_c1)
adjacency_c1[upper.tri(adjacency_c1)] <- t[upper.tri(t)]  
diag(adjacency_c1) <- 1 # add 1s to diagonal

adjacency_c2<-AdjacencyFromEdgelist(edgelist_c2, check.full = TRUE)
adjacency_c2<-adjacency_c2[["adjacency"]]
t<-t(adjacency_c2)
adjacency_c2[upper.tri(adjacency_c2)] <- t[upper.tri(t)]  
diag(adjacency_c2) <- 1 # add 1s to diagonal

adjacency_c3<-AdjacencyFromEdgelist(edgelist_c3, check.full = TRUE)
adjacency_c3<-adjacency_c3[["adjacency"]]
t<-t(adjacency_c3)
adjacency_c3[upper.tri(adjacency_c3)] <- t[upper.tri(t)]  
diag(adjacency_c3) <- 1 # add 1s to diagonal

adjacency_c4<-AdjacencyFromEdgelist(edgelist_c4, check.full = TRUE)
adjacency_c4<-adjacency_c4[["adjacency"]]
t<-t(adjacency_c4)
adjacency_c4[upper.tri(adjacency_c4)] <- t[upper.tri(t)]  
diag(adjacency_c4) <- 1 # add 1s to diagonal

# heatmaps
corrplot(adjacency_c1, type = "upper", method = "color", tl.cex = 0.2, title="rsfc cluster1", mar=c(0,0,1,0))
corrplot(adjacency_c2, type = "upper", method = "color", tl.cex = 0.2, title="rsfc cluster2", mar=c(0,0,1,0))
corrplot(adjacency_c3, type = "upper", method = "color", tl.cex = 0.2, title="rsfc cluster3", mar=c(0,0,1,0))
corrplot(adjacency_c4, type = "upper", method = "color", tl.cex = 0.2, title="rsfccluster4", mar=c(0,0,1,0))
```

## Associations between LOC, brainstem-occipital cortex rsFC, and the line orientation test


```{r}
library(dplyr)

clustering.fused.2<-read.csv(here("data/pnc/pilot-snf/clusters_fused_2.csv"))
clustering.fused.3<-read.csv(here("data/pnc/pilot-snf/clusters_fused_3.csv"))
clustering.fused<-cbind(clustering.fused.2, clustering.fused.3[,3])
colnames(clustering.fused)[4]<- "cluster.3"

# Bring in outcomes .csv 

outcomes<-read.csv(here("data/pnc/pilot-snf/tbi_pnc_outcomes.csv"), fill = TRUE, header = T)

clustering.fused<-merge(clustering.fused, outcomes, by="SUBJID", all.x=T)
clustering.fused[c('X.x')]<-NULL
clustering.fused[c('X.y')]<-NULL


# LOC
loc_data <- clustering.clinical |>
    dplyr::select(SUBJID, cluster.3, TBI_LOC)

# Line orientation test
lot_data <- clustering.fused |>
    dplyr::select(SUBJID, cluster.3, PLOT_TC)

# Brainstem-occipital cortex rsFC
# Identifying the rsFC values of each subject
# In the original script, subjects were pooled together within clusters before rsFC means were calculated
# Naming the columns with prefixes so we can easily see the cluster membership post-merge
c1.rsfc.by.con<-subset(rsfc.by.con, cluster.3==1)
c1.rsfc.by.con<-c1.rsfc.by.con[,c(5,7:ncol(c1.rsfc.by.con))]
c1.rsfc.by.con<-t(c1.rsfc.by.con)
c1.rsfc.by.con<-as.data.frame(c1.rsfc.by.con)
c1.rsfc.by.con$c1.mean<-rowMeans(c1.rsfc.by.con)
colnames(c1.rsfc.by.con) <- c1.rsfc.by.con[1, ]
c1.rsfc.by.con <- c1.rsfc.by.con[-c(1), ]

c2.rsfc.by.con<-subset(rsfc.by.con, cluster.3==2)
c2.rsfc.by.con<-c2.rsfc.by.con[,c(5,7:ncol(c2.rsfc.by.con))]
c2.rsfc.by.con<-t(c2.rsfc.by.con)
c2.rsfc.by.con<-as.data.frame(c2.rsfc.by.con)
c2.rsfc.by.con$c2.mean<-rowMeans(c2.rsfc.by.con)
colnames(c2.rsfc.by.con)
colnames(c2.rsfc.by.con) <- c2.rsfc.by.con[1, ]
c2.rsfc.by.con <- c2.rsfc.by.con[-c(1), ]

c3.rsfc.by.con<-subset(rsfc.by.con, cluster.3==3)
c3.rsfc.by.con<-c3.rsfc.by.con[,c(5,7:ncol(c3.rsfc.by.con))]
c3.rsfc.by.con<-t(c3.rsfc.by.con)
c3.rsfc.by.con<-as.data.frame(c3.rsfc.by.con)
c3.rsfc.by.con$c3.mean<-rowMeans(c3.rsfc.by.con)
colnames(c3.rsfc.by.con) <- c3.rsfc.by.con[1, ]
c3.rsfc.by.con <- c3.rsfc.by.con[-c(1), ]

c1_rsfc_by_con_cnamed <- c1.rsfc.by.con |> rename_with( ~ paste0("c1_", .x))
c2_rsfc_by_con_cnamed <- c2.rsfc.by.con |> rename_with( ~ paste0("c2_", .x))
c3_rsfc_by_con_cnamed <- c3.rsfc.by.con |> rename_with( ~ paste0("c3_", .x))

colnames(c1_rsfc_by_con_cnamed)

# Dropping the last column, which was row-wise means
cluster_edges_full <- cbind(edgelist,
                            c1_rsfc_by_con_cnamed[1:length(c1_rsfc_by_con_cnamed) - 1],
                            c2_rsfc_by_con_cnamed[1:length(c2_rsfc_by_con_cnamed) - 1],
                            c3_rsfc_by_con_cnamed[1:length(c3_rsfc_by_con_cnamed) - 1])

cluster_edges_full_bs_oct <- subset(cluster_edges_full, V1.lobe=="brainstem" & V2.lobe=="occipital" | V1.lobe=="occipital" & V2.lobe=="brainstem")

just_subjects <- cluster_edges_full_bs_oct |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("c"))

rsfc_summaries <- just_subjects |>
    summarise(across(everything(), mean))

c1_vals <- rsfc_summaries |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("c1")) |>
    t() |>
    data.frame()
c1_vals <- cbind(rownames(c1_vals), data.frame(c1_vals, row.names=NULL), "1")
colnames(c1_vals) = c("SUBJID", "bs_oct_rsfc", "cluster.3")

c2_vals <- rsfc_summaries |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("c2")) |>
    t() |>
    data.frame()
c2_vals <- cbind(rownames(c2_vals), data.frame(c2_vals, row.names=NULL), "2")
colnames(c2_vals) = c("SUBJID", "bs_oct_rsfc", "cluster.3")

c3_vals <- rsfc_summaries |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("c3")) |>
    t() |>
    data.frame()
c3_vals <- cbind(rownames(c3_vals), data.frame(c3_vals, row.names=NULL), "3")
colnames(c3_vals) = c("SUBJID", "bs_oct_rsfc", "cluster.3")

rsfc_data <- rbind(c1_vals, c2_vals, c3_vals)
rsfc_data$SUBJID <- substring(rsfc_data$SUBJID, 4)

ggplot(rsfc_data, aes(x = cluster.3, y = bs_oct_rsfc)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_point() +
    ylim(-0.2, 0.3)

# 1. Is bs_oct_rsfc significantly lower in cluster 3?
summary(aov(bs_oct_rsfc ~ cluster.3, data = rsfc_data)) # p = 0.146


## For carbon
#ggsave(here("data/pnc/pilot-snf/3_cluster_bs_oct_rsfc_per_subject.png"),
#    width = 10,
#    height = 10)
#
## For this repo
#ggsave(here("figures/pnc/pilot-snf/3_cluster_bs_oct_rsfc_per_subject.png"),
#    width = 10,
#    height = 10)

# Association checks - Across all subjects
head(rsfc_data)
head(loc_data)
head(lot_data)

rsfc_data$SUBJID <- as.character(rsfc_data$SUBJID)
loc_data$SUBJID <- as.character(loc_data$SUBJID)
lot_data$SUBJID <- as.character(lot_data$SUBJID)

rsfc_data$cluster.3 <- as.factor(rsfc_data$cluster.3)
loc_data$cluster.3 <- as.factor(loc_data$cluster.3)
lot_data$cluster.3 <- as.factor(lot_data$cluster.3)


association_df <-
    inner_join(rsfc_data, loc_data, by = c("cluster.3", "SUBJID"))
association_df <-
    inner_join(association_df, lot_data, by = c("cluster.3", "SUBJID"))

colnames(association_df)

# rsfc VS line orientation test
cor.test(association_df$PLOT_TC, association_df$bs_oct_rsfc, use = "complete.obs")$p.value
# p-value: 0.47161

ggplot(association_df, mapping = aes_string(x = "PLOT_TC", y = "bs_oct_rsfc")) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method=lm, se=TRUE)
```
